amount.description: An object containing the amount of the grant, in [minor units](https://docs.adyen.com/development-resources/currency-codes).

balances.description: An object containing the details of the existing grant.

counterparty.description: An object containing the details of the receiving party of the grant. Setting either an `accountHolderId`, `balanceAccountId`, or both is required.

fee.description: An object containing the fee currency and value, in [minor units](https://docs.adyen.com/development-resources/currency-codes).

grantAccountId.description: The identifier of the grant account used for the grant.

grantOfferId.description: The identifier of the grant offer that has been selected and from which the grant details will be used.

id.description: The identifier of the grant reference.

repayment.description: An object containing the details of the 30-day repayment threshold.

status.description: The current status of the grant. Possible values: **Pending**, **Active**, **Repaid**.

value.description: The amount of the transaction, in [minor units](https://docs.adyen.com/development-resources/currency-codes).

total.description: Total amount. A sum of principal amount and fee amount.

accountHolderId.description: The identifier of the receiving account holder. The payout will default to the primary balance account of this account holder if no `balanceAccountId` is provided.

balanceAccountId.description: The identifier of the balance account that belongs to the receiving account holder.

transferInstrumentId.description: The identifier of the transfer instrument that belongs to the legal entity of the account holder.

amount.description: An object containing the fee amount.

basisPoints.description: The repayment that is deducted daily from incoming net volume, in [basis points](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/b/basispoint.asp).

term.description: An object containing the details of the configuration for repayment term.

threshold.description: An object containing the details of the 30-day repayment threshold.

estimatedDays.description: The estimated term for repaying the grant, in days.

maximumDays.description: The maximum term for repaying the grant, in days. Only applies when `contractType` is **loan**.

amount.description: The amount to be repaid on a 30-day basis.
